description.value: Raven's Nest is an on-mountain restaurant operated by Whistler Blackcomb, located in the Alder Creek area of Whistler Mountain and accessible via gondola. The OSM record includes Indigenous-language names in both Lil'wat (Yecwláo7) and Squamish (Sḵewḵ'), reflecting recognition of the First Nations whose traditional territory the resort occupies. In summer it serves guests of the Whistler Mountain Bike Park, making it a natural mid-ride stop for lift-assisted mountain bikers descending the mountain.
